answer: Your records list no allergies. The allergy section is empty in everything the hospital sent (pulls from 2024, 2025 and October 2026). That is not the same as a confirmed 'no known allergies' entry, though: the records don't say that anyone checked and found none. If you have ever reacted to a medicine, food or anything else, tell your care team so it can be added. Nothing in your medicines or other records suggests a reaction.
short: No allergies are recorded in her health records, but there is also no explicit 'no known allergies' statement.
